questions.question: Which ecologist showed in a long-term experiment on outdoor plots that biodiversity is of central importance to the productivity, stability, resistance to the invasion of ecosystems and fertility of their soils?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**David Tilman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **David Tilman:-**

 
 
• He showed in his long-term experiment on outdoor plots that biodiversity is essential to the productivity, stability, resistance to invasion of ecosystems, and fertility of their soils.
 
• His experiment involved growing different combinations of plant species and measuring the resulting productivity and stability of the ecosystem.
 
• The results showed that ecosystems with higher biodiversity were more productive and stable, and had greater resistance to invasion by non-native species.
 
• This experiment supports the idea that preserving biodiversity is crucial for maintaining healthy and functioning ecosystems. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karl Mobius:-**

 
 
• He was a German zoologist who studied marine ecosystems, but did not conduct research on the importance of biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Herbert Spencer:-**
 
 
• He was a 19th-century philosopher and sociologist who did not conduct any research on ecology or biodiversity.
 
 
 
• **Edward Osborne Wilson:-**
 
 
• He is a renowned biologist who has done extensive research on biodiversity.

• HyperText Markup Language:-

 
 
• First developed by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990, HTML is short for Hypertext Markup Language.
 
• HTML is used to create electronic documents (called pages) that are displayed on the World Wide Web.
 
• It is a language used for writing source codes for developing a webpage, inserting content, and other components in it.
 
• HTML is a markup language because it is used to distinguish HTML elements from the text.
 
• HTML is not a programming language, meaning it doesn’t have the ability to create dynamic functionality. Instead, it makes it possible to organize and format documents, similar to Microsoft Word.

questions.question: What is the name of the technology developed by Australian scientists to transform soybean oil into graphene?
questions.solution:
• GraphAir is the technology that has been developed by Australian Scientists to transform soybean oil into graphene.
 
• This technology grows graphene film with a natural precursor in ambient air, thus making its production simpler and faster.

questions.question: In 1830, which American scientist created the world's most powerful electromagnet, the Alnany magnet, which could lift up to 750 pounds of metal at a time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Joseph Henry**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Joseph Henry:-**

 
 
• He was an American scientist who is best known for his work in electromagnetism. He discovered the phenomenon of self-induction and mutual induction independently of Michael Faraday.
 
• In 1830, Joseph Henry created the world's most powerful electromagnet, the Albany magnet, which could lift up to 750 pounds of metal at a time. This was a significant achievement in the field of electromagnetism. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **John Cockcroft:-**

 
 
• He was a British physicist who is known for his work on the splitting of the atom.
 
• He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1951 for his contributions to nuclear physics.
 
 
 
• **William Gilbert:-**
 
 
• He was an English physician and natural philosopher who is known as the father of electrical studies.
 
• He is credited with the discovery of the Earth's magnetic field and the invention of the term "electricity."
 
 
 
• **Edward Purcell:-**
 
 
• He was an American physicist who is known for his work on nuclear magnetic resonance.
 
• He was awarded the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1952 for his contributions to the development of the nuclear magnetic resonance method.

questions.question: In which year did Hans Christian Oersted discover that a compass needle gets deflected when an electric current passes through a metallic wire placed nearby?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1820**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1820** is the year when Hans Christian Oersted discovered that a compass needle gets deflected by an electric current passing through a nearby metallic wire.
 
• Hans Christian Oersted was a Danish physicist and chemist who is known for this discovery, which showed a direct relationship between electricity and magnetism.
 
• This experiment laid the foundation for the field of electromagnetism, significantly influencing future scientific research and technological advancements.
 
• The discovery was a pivotal moment in the study of electromagnetism and led to the development of various technologies like electric motors and generators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hans Christian Oersted's discovery was accidental; he noticed the deflection of the compass needle while preparing for a lecture demonstration.
 
• This phenomenon demonstrated the fundamental connection between electric currents and magnetic fields, which was later formulated into Ampère's circuital law by André-Marie Ampère.
 
• Oersted's work was part of the broader 19th-century scientific movement that included contributions from other prominent scientists such as Michael Faraday and James Clerk Maxwell.
 
• The unit of magnetic field strength, the oersted (Oe), is named in his honor.

questions.question: What numerical scale was introduced in 1932 that determined the electronegativity of fluorine to be 4.0?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pauling scale**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Electronegativity,** a concept pioneered by **Linus Pauling in 1932,** measures an atom's ability within a molecule to attract electrons towards itself. It's described as "the power of an atom in a molecule to attract electrons to itself."
 
• On the Pauling scale, fluorine is set as the benchmark with an electronegativity of 3.98, and other elements are gauged relative to this value.
 
• Essentially, an atom's electronegativity indicates its tendency to pull electron density towards itself when forming bonds.
 
• Higher electronegativity signifies a stronger pull on electrons during bonding.
 
• Atomic number and atomic radius largely influence an atom's electronegativity.
 
• Across the periodic table, electronegativity generally increases from left to right and from bottom to top.
 
• Consequently, fluorine stands as the most electronegative element, while francium exhibits the least electronegativity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **The Allred-Rochow Electronegativity **method quantifies the electrostatic force resulting from the effective nuclear charge acting on the valence electrons of an atom.
 
• Mulliken's scale of electronegativity defines electronegativity as an inherent characteristic of an element, solely contingent on the valence state of the atom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Electronegativity** is the measure of an atom's ability to attract shared electrons in a covalent bond. A higher electronegativity value indicates a stronger attraction for the shared electrons. 
 
• This property follows a predictable trend across the periodic table: electronegativity generally increases from bottom to top within groups and from left to right across periods. 
 
• Consequently, fluorine holds the title of the most electronegative element, whereas francium ranks among the least electronegative.

questions.question: Name the web portal launched by the Department of Telecommunication sharing information on mobile towers and EMF Emission Compliances.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Tarang Sanchar__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Tarang Sanchar, a web portal for information sharing on mobile towers and EMF Emission Compliances, has been launched by the Department of Telecom (DoT), Ministry of Communications, to generate confidence and conviction about the safety and harmlessness of mobile towers, as well as dispelling myths and misconceptions.
 
• The EMF Portal provides a public interface with a simple map-based search tool for seeing mobile towers in the neighborhood of any location.
 
• Anyone may request an EMF emission measurement at a site by paying a small cost of Rs. 4000/- online.
 
• The test will be conducted by the DoT's Local Telecom Enforcement Resource and Monitoring (TERM) filed unit (the requestor may be present if he so wishes), and test reports will be supplied.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Optical Fibre Network (NOFN)**: An initiative aimed at connecting 250,000-gram panchayats with optical fiber to improve broadband access in rural India.
 
• **BharatNet**: The upgraded version of NOFN, focusing on providing high-speed internet connectivity to rural and remote areas through a robust optical fiber infrastructure.
 
• **Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL)**: A state-owned telecommunications company in India that plays a crucial role in providing telecom services, including broadband, across urban and rural areas.

questions.question: Which one of the following is deﬁned as "a private network that uses Internet technology and the public telecommunication system to securely share part of a business's information or operations with suppliers, vendors, partners, customers or other businesses"?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2, i.e. Extranet.

__
 
• **Extranet**__ refers to a network within an organization, using the internet to connect to the outsiders in a controlled manner.
 
• It helps to connect businesses with their customers and suppliers and therefore allows working in a collaborative manner.
 
• It is implemented as a Virtual Private Networks (VPN) because it uses the internet to connect to corporate organization and there is always a threat to information security.
 
• VPN offers a secure network in public infrastructure.
